title: PSU banks rally on renewed merger talk

timeline.title: PSU banks rally on renewed merger talk
timeline.line: Nifty PSU Bank rose about 2.4%, with PNB up 3–4% and Canara Bank up about 3%
more: The merger talk is reported, not confirmed by the government
Univest also cites better earnings and cleaner balance sheets
31 of 38 banking stocks were higher in one morning snapshot

src.title: PSU Bank Stocks Rally on Merger Buzz: PNB, BoI, SBI Gain
